tasks.title: Lecture #68
tasks.instruction: Listen to a talk in a history class.
tasks.transcript:
The Magna Carta, also known as the Great Charter, was signed in 1215 by King John of England. It was a pivotal document that limited the power of the monarchy and laid the groundwork for constitutional law. The Magna Carta introduced several fundamental legal principles, including the idea that the King must govern according to the law and that all free men have the right to a fair trial. One of its most famous clauses states that no person shall be deprived of life, liberty, or property without due process of law. This principle has become a cornerstone of legal systems around the world.
While the Magna Carta was initially intended to address the grievances of rebellious barons, its influence has extended far since then. Over the centuries, it has inspired numerous legal documents, including the United States Constitution and the Universal Declaration of Human Rights. Its legacy continues to be felt in discussions about individual rights and the rule of law. Let's now talk about some of the specifics of this historic document.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the talk?

options.A: The reign of King John of England
options.B: The importance of a specific document

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：这段谈话的主要话题是什么？ 定位原文：The Magna Carta... was a pivotal document that limited the power of the monarchy and laid the groundwork for constitutional law. （全文围绕《大宪章》的内容、影响和遗产展开） 选项分析： A. The reign of King John of England 英格兰国王约翰的统治。谈话中提到国王约翰签署《大宪章》，但不是主要内容，所以A选项错误。 B. The importance of a specific document 一份特定文件的重要性。谈话主要讲述《大宪章》的重要性、法律原则及其深远影响，所以B选项正确。 C. The grievances of English barons 英国贵族的不满。谈话中提到《大宪章》最初是为了解决贵族的不满，但不是主要内容，所以C选项错误。 D. The history of England since 1215 1215年以来的英格兰历史。谈话中未全面讲述英格兰历史，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: According to the speaker, what was an immediate effect of the Magna Carta?

options.A: The king's power was no longer unlimited.
options.C: Some important people had to face a trial.
options.D: Some men were freed from prison.

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：根据说话者，《大宪章》的直接效果是什么？ 定位原文：It was a pivotal document that limited the power of the monarchy... 选项分析： A. The king's power was no longer unlimited. 国王的权力不再不受限制。《大宪章》直接限制了君主权力，所以A选项正确。 B. Access to private property increased. 对私有财产的获取增加了。谈话中未提及，所以B选项错误。 C. Some important people had to face a trial. 一些重要人物不得不面对审判。谈话中提到“所有自由人都有权获得公平审判”，但不是直接效果，所以C选项错误。 D. Some men were freed from prison. 一些人被从监狱释放。谈话中未提及，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: Why does the speaker mention the United States Constitution and the Universal Declaration of Human Rights?

options.A: To highlight the Magna Carta's far - reaching influence
options.B: To explain the legal principle of due process
options.C: To compare the importance of two legal documents
options.D: To identify two legal documents that may seem to contradict each other

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：说话者为什么提到《美国宪法》和《世界人权宣言》？ 定位原文：Over the centuries, it has inspired numerous legal documents, including the United States Constitution and the Universal Declaration of Human Rights. 选项分析： A. To highlight the Magna Carta's far-reaching influence 强调《大宪章》的深远影响。说话者用这两个重要文件作为例子，说明《大宪章》启发了后来的众多法律文件，所以A选项正确。 B. To explain the legal principle of due process 解释正当法律程序的原则。谈话中提到这一原则是《大宪章》提出的，但提及这两个文件不是为了解释该原则，所以B选项错误。 C. To compare the importance of two legal documents 比较两个法律文件的重要性。谈话中未比较重要性，所以C选项错误。 D. To identify two legal documents that may seem to contradict each other 指出两份看似矛盾的法律文件。谈话中未提及矛盾，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What will the speaker discuss next?

options.A: The history of the idea of human rights
options.B: Details about the Magna Carta's contents
options.C: The preservation of an old document

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：说话者接下来将讨论什么？ 定位原文：Let's now talk about some of the specifics of this historic document. 选项分析： A. The history of the idea of human rights 人权观念的历史。谈话中未明确提及接下来要讲这个，所以A选项错误。 B. Details about the Magna Carta's contents 《大宪章》内容的具体细节。说话者明确说“接下来谈谈这份历史文件的一些具体内容”，所以B选项正确。 C. The preservation of an old document 一份旧文件的保存。谈话中未提及，所以C选项错误。 D. Additional examples of human rights 人权的其他例子。谈话中未明确提及，所以D选项错误。
